item.title: Cargo-Lite 2.0 ships a shared build cache
item.description: Cargo-Lite 2.0 was released on Tuesday. The headline feature is a shared build cache keyed by the content hash of each crate. One company reported that clean builds dropped from 41 minutes to 6. The old TOML configuration format is removed in 3.0; a migration command rewrites it. The cache can live on local disk or on any S3-compatible bucket.

item.title: Postmortem: payments database down 4 hours after one long transaction
item.description: The postmortem describes a nightly report query that ran inside a transaction for 51 minutes, holding a lock on the payments table. Writers queued, connection pools filled, and the API returned errors for four hours. Fixes: statement timeouts of 30 seconds on application roles, the report moved to a read replica, and an alert on transactions older than five minutes.

item.title: Credential dump exposes 12 million passwords from Lumen breach
item.description: A file containing 12 million email and password pairs from the Lumen breach was posted on a public forum. Lumen says the passwords were hashed with bcrypt and that it has forced a reset for all accounts. Security researchers recommend users who reused the password elsewhere change it. The company has not said how the attackers got in.

item.title: Nimbus lays off 30 percent after missing revenue targets
item.description: Nimbus, a cloud infrastructure startup, laid off 180 employees, about 30 percent of its staff, after missing its revenue target for the second quarter in a row. The company said it will focus on its managed database product and stop selling its edge network service. Customers of the edge service have six months to migrate.

item.title: Local football derby ends in a draw after late equaliser
item.description: The city derby ended two all after a late equaliser. The sports section recaps the match, the injuries, and the table. Fans celebrated in the streets until midnight and the police reported no incidents.
